That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you make a final decision tomorrow, could we talk tonight? You don’t have to keep suffering, but it might help to think through your options—taking a day off, setting boundaries, looking for another job, or quitting if that truly is the right choice. ## 2

I understand why some people become skeptical, especially when institutions and images can be manipulated. But the evidence that Earth is round comes from many independent sources, not just photographs from space: ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and people have circumnavigated the planet. Satellites, GPS, and communications systems also rely on models that account for Earth’s shape. It’s reasonable to ask questions, but the overall evidence strongly supports a spherical Earth.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more than most other colors because it has shorter waves. So when you look across the sky, blue light is reaching your eyes from all around you.

You might wonder why the sky isn’t violet, since violet scatters even more. The Sun gives us less violet light, and our eyes are more sensitive to blue, so the sky usually looks blue to us.

雨落在深夜的街道上，细密而连续，像一层透明的帘子，把城市笼在朦胧的水汽里。路灯映在积水中，随着涟漪摇碎成金色的光。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，轮胎溅起水花，声音很快又被雨声吞没。窗边的人捧着一杯热茶，听雨敲打玻璃，屋内安静而温暖，仿佛整个世界都暂时放慢了脚步，只剩下夜色、灯影和绵长的雨声。
